scenes.narration: Bumi Angling Darma mencetak sejarah! Rilis data BPS per 2 November 2026 mencatat: Kabupaten Bojonegoro jadi penghasil padi nomor satu di Jawa Timur!
scenes.visual_concept: Establishing landscape: Editorial flat-vector sunrise over geometric terraced rice fields with layered hills, dramatic sun disk rising, and bold typography announcement with golden laurel leaf monument.
scenes.camera: Subtle slow crane down and forward push
scenes.motion: Masked geometric reveals of hills, sunray rotation, staggered number countup

scenes.narration: Secara nasional, Jawa Timur kembali kokoh sebagai produsen padi terbesar di Indonesia dengan total 10,61 juta ton Gabah Kering Giling.
scenes.visual_concept: Geographic scale: Editorial vector map of Jawa Timur with clean polygon shade planes, glowing Bojonegoro centroid beacon, accompanied by flat isometric data towers comparing top 4 national provinces.
scenes.camera: Smooth continental zoom into East Java province
scenes.motion: Sequential province bar elevation, animated dashed trade lines, pulsing target rings

scenes.narration: Dan penopang terbesarnya, ada di Bojonegoro! Dengan luas panen 159 ribu hektar, Bojonegoro memimpin di puncak dengan torehan 868.808 ton gabah!
scenes.visual_concept: Harvest supremacy: Flat vector combine harvester cutting golden paddy geometry, paired with editorial podium infographic showing top 3 regencies: Bojonegoro 868.808 Ton, Lamongan 852.192 Ton, Ngawi 768.307 Ton.
scenes.camera: Tracking agricultural action to side-by-side leaderboard
scenes.motion: Parallax movement of field rows, smooth horizontal bar expansion, badge float

scenes.narration: Kalau dikonversi jadi beras siap konsumsi, Bojonegoro menyuplai lebih dari 501 ribu ton beras untuk kebutuhan pangan masyarakat.
scenes.visual_concept: Modern agro-industrial processing: Cross-section editorial milling facility showing golden paddy converting into gleaming white rice grains via geometric conveyor vectors, leading to packed 501.670 Ton supply.
scenes.camera: Horizontal conveyor pan with process stages
scenes.motion: Continuous chevron flow, rice grain vector particles, dynamic fill ratio bar

scenes.narration: Bukti nyata kerja keras petani dan sinergi pemerintah menjaga kedaulatan pangan. Matur nuwun petani Bojonegoro! Wong Bojonegoro, bangga nggak nih? Tulis di komentar!
scenes.visual_concept: Grand triumphant finale: Editorial heroic silhouette of agricultural prosperity with golden sun, large commemorative crest, summary quadrant data cards, and bold interactive call to action.
scenes.camera: Wide triumphant pull back to complete composition framing
scenes.motion: Harmonic paddy swaying, soft background ring breathing, interactive comment CTA
